Discovery.description: Runtime capability states of the running bridge. `state` is the artifact state lowered by runtime switches (a served capability whose module or write switch is off is DISABLED with a blocker). openapi_sha256 is the sha256 of the exact openapi.json bytes this build renders; HQ trusts runtime states only when it equals the pinned hash. policy_revision is the pinned, verified access-policy revision.

Health.description: Aggregate health (HQ shape). services lists the bridge and every owner it is configured to probe; an owner without a probe is omitted (never shown as OK). Overall: DOWN when the bridge's own database is down, DEGRADED when a listed service is not OK, UNKNOWN when no owner probe is configured, otherwise OK.

OperationReadback.description: One command as the bridge's operations ledger holds it, keyed by the Idempotency-Key HQ sent (bridge.operations.read). SUCCEEDED and FAILED are settled and never change. UNKNOWN_OUTCOME and SENT are settled only from the owning service's own record of that key, never by resending: FAILED with source_status NOT_RECEIVED when the owner has no record after 600 s, NOT_SENT when the bridge never sent it.

AuditEntryPage.description: The bridge's hash-chained audit of HQ requests (allowed and refused), oldest first. next_cursor is the last sequence. Never a body, a request digest or a path.

PrivacyRequest.description: One data-subject request tracked across the services that hold the person's data (design §6.14). OPEN until every service has an outcome, then COMPLETE. The bridge keeps the kind, the opaque CF Meet account id and each service's outcome only. version increases on every change.

subject_ref.description: The CF Meet account id the request is about.

PrivacyRegisterRequest.description: Register a request (expected_version 0: a new resource; its request_id is the operation_id). Every service starts PENDING. TWO_PERSON.

PrivacyCompleteServiceRequest.description: Record one service's outcome after its owner action, at the request's version. A recorded outcome never changes. TWO_PERSON.

Dataset.description: One certified HQ dataset over a UTC day window. Metric names are fixed per dataset (datasets.v1.json); a metric the bridge could not establish is null, never zero. coverage is COMPLETE only when every source reported every day of the window.

ProjectionStatus.description: Freshness and coverage of every bridge projection (owner events -> summaries). Until owner events are wired (phase A7) every projection reports UNAVAILABLE.

OrganizationDetail.description: Operational view of one business organization. Contact details (address, public email, registration number) are never included.

OrganizationAuditEvent.description: One organization audit event: who, what, when and the target. The owner's free-form summary is not relayed.

OrganizationMember.description: One membership. The member is an opaque CF Meet user id; no name or email.

OrganizationPolicies.description: The organization's policy document (Organizations PolicyDocument v1, field by field). Sections the bridge has not reviewed are not relayed.

OrganizationTeam.description: One team. Its free-text description is not relayed.

OrganizationBinding.description: One automatic or operator service binding of the organization's primary scope. Service account and credential ids are not relayed; no secret is ever held by the owner response.

NotificationDelivery.description: One notification delivery: ids, category, lane, channel, state and times. Never an address, handle, code, token or rendered text.

NotificationSuppression.description: The effective suppression of one recipient, by the Notification Service's keyed digest only. The address is never relayed.

NotificationRouting.description: Routing per category and channel, and the hourly route audit (accepted decisions per producer and category).

NotificationProviders.description: Per-channel provider status from configuration and recent deliveries. Never a credential, key or provider response.

PartnerWorkspace.description: One partner workspace (Developer Platform organization). No support address.

PartnerWorkspaceDetail.description: One partner workspace with member and project counts. No support address.

PartnerActivityEvent.description: One operator command in the workspace's activity (who, what, outcome, when). The command's free-form summary is not relayed.

PartnerProject.description: One project of a workspace. No description, labels or support address.

PartnerEnvironment.description: One environment of a workspace's project.

PartnerMember.description: One workspace membership. The member is an opaque CF Meet user id; no name or address.

PartnerInvitation.description: One workspace invitation. The invitee's address is never relayed.

PartnerPushKey.description: Push credential DETAILS of an environment: provider identifiers and the credential fingerprint. The credential itself never leaves the owner's vault.

PartnerUsage.description: Metered usage of one environment and usage type over the window (quantities only).

PartnerUsagePage.description: The workspace's usage over the window's UTC days [from, to].

PartnerIncident.description: One incident recorded against a workspace's support profile (the reference and time the operator gave).

PartnerWebhook.description: One live webhook subscription: the endpoint HOST only (never the URL path or query, the signing material or the description).

PartnerWebhookDelivery.description: One webhook delivery outcome (no payload, no response body).

AppSummary.description: One CF Meet App (the current manifest's name and distribution).

AppDetail.description: One CF Meet App for review: versions, directory listing, the developer's workspace name, the last decision and the review history. Manifest URLs and test accounts are not relayed.

AppVersion.description: One manifest version of an app (name and distribution only).

AppInstall.description: One installation grant of an app. Targets are opaque ids; scopes are counted, not listed.

PricingPriceBook.description: One price book (a lineage of versions for a product line and market).

PricingVersion.description: One price version (its state and content digest; no rates).

PricingVersionDetail.description: One price version with its content and who drafted, submitted and approved it.

items.description: The rate of one usage type.
A graduated tier over the quantity beyond the included amount (up_to null: open).

limits.description: Plan limits (an override sets a subset; an absent limit is null).

PricingActivation.description: One append-only activation of a price version.

PricingPlan.description: One CF Meet user plan of a CONSUMER lineage's effective version (FREE always).

limits.description: Plan limits (an override sets a subset; an absent limit is null).

PricingPlanPage.description: Every plan in one page (next_cursor is always null).

PricingPlanAssignment.description: One plan assignment of a user or organization (append-only history).

limits.description: Plan limits (an override sets a subset; an absent limit is null).

PricingChargeSimulationRequest.description: What a usage vector (PARTNER_PLATFORM: usage) or a plan (CONSUMER: plan_code, cycle) would cost under a version (default: the lineage's effective one). A read: nothing is charged and nothing changes.

PricingChargeSimulation.description: An estimate in minor units of the book's currency (never a charge).

items.description: One priced usage type: quantities and the amount in minor units.

FinanceUsageRow.description: Metered usage of one workspace and usage type over the window.

FinanceUsageReport.description: Usage per workspace over the window's UTC days [from, to] (at most 31 days).

FinanceWorkspaceCharges.description: The estimated charges of one workspace.

items.description: One priced usage type: quantities and the amount in minor units.

FinanceEstimatedChargesReport.description: Estimated charges (an estimate, one currency, minor units) under the PARTNER_PLATFORM price book of the request's market, over the window's UTC days [from, to].

FinancePlanSpread.description: Holders on one plan, and those assigned to it in the window.

FinancePlanSpreadReport.description: The plan spread as of the window's end (one bounded list).

IdentityEnvironment.description: One environment of a tenant's application.

IdentityServiceAccount.description: One service account. Its free-text description is not relayed.

IdentityScopeGrant.description: One scope granted to an application.

IdentityKey.description: One API key: its public id and last four characters, scopes, state and times. Never the secret, the verifier, its algorithm or key version, or the free-text label.

version.description: revision plus suspend/resume changes: the key commands' expected_version.

IdentityPrincipal.description: One principal (identity record; partner users are kind EXTERNAL_APPLICATION_PRINCIPAL). Its external reference is never relayed.

PartnerWebsites.description: The allowed websites (origins) of one environment of a partner workspace; empty when none were set.

IdentityOAuthApp.description: One CF Meet Apps OAuth client. The number of redirect URIs, never the URIs or the test accounts.

IdentityAppGrant.description: One grant (installation) of an OAuth app. Accounts and organizations are opaque CF Meet ids.

IdentityAuditEntry.description: One Platform Access operator audit row, without its detail.

CommunicationProfile.description: One Communications profile by CF Meet ID: display name (R1 detail read), activation state, operator hold and times. Never a phone number, email address or account reference.

CommunicationReport.description: One profile report (safety evidence): reason, both parties' current CF Meet IDs, the target's report count and the review. Reports carry no free text.

version.description: 1 while open, 2 once reviewed: communications.report.review's expected_version.

CommunicationHold.description: One operator hold on a profile.

CommunicationAuditEvent.description: One Communications Hub audit event: operation, actor and resource ids, time. The free-form details are not relayed.

AccountUser.description: One CF Meet account. Search matches on the email address but never returns it.

version.description: The account's version (expected_version of the account commands).

AccountUserDetail.description: One account in detail (R1, every read audited). The email address only masked.

version.description: The account's version (expected_version of the account commands).

email_masked.description: First character of the local part and of the domain label, the top-level domain kept (a***@e***.com), or *** when unusual. Only a masked value can match; never the address.

AccountSession.description: One account session: method, times and revocation. No client label, no token.

AccountDevice.description: One Account device: class, platform, trust, state and times. No label, key or digest.

AccountMfa.description: MFA status: TOTP enrolment state and the count of unused recovery codes. Never a secret or a code.

AccountSecurityEvent.description: One account security event (sign-ins and changes): type, outcome, actor kind and time. No detail, IP address or location.

MeetingSpace.description: One meeting space. No description, passcode or policy documents.

MeetingConference.description: One meeting (conference): state, times and participant counts. No room names or provider ids.

MeetingParticipant.description: One participant. No guest identity, external reference, credential or denial note.

MeetingAuditEvent.description: One conference audit event. No actor or target reference, metadata or request id.

AccountDuplicates.description: Accounts sharing a normalized email address or username (account ids only; never the value). One bounded answer.

email_uniqueness.description: Whether uniqueness is enforced, and the groups of accounts that share a value (ids only).

username_uniqueness.description: Whether uniqueness is enforced, and the groups of accounts that share a value (ids only).

AccountTestAccount.description: One review test account: its address masked, and the account it belongs to (never the code).

MeetingWebinar.description: One webinar or town hall space with its registration counts.

MeetingWebinarPage.description: Webinars created in [start, end): the window is applied to each owner page, so a page may hold fewer than limit; follow next_cursor.

MeetingWebinarRegistration.description: One webinar registration: ids, state and times (no registrant name or address).

MeetingChatMigration.description: The meeting-chat migration state, version and gates (counts and the latest parity run).

MeetingCriticalLane.description: The account CRITICAL notification lane: counts, the fallback key's readiness and the leased, uncompleted decision ids.

MessagingReport.description: One chat report: ids, category, states and times. The evidence itself (a sealed reporter disclosure or a MANAGED message reference) is never relayed; evidence_kind only says which kind was given.

version.description: The report's row version (expected_version of its moderation commands).

MessagingReportDetail.description: One chat report and its moderation actions (no evidence).

items.description: One moderation action taken on the report.

MessagingHold.description: One legal hold. The case reference is not relayed: reason_category says why.

MessagingExport.description: One MANAGED conversation export (encrypted chats are never exported). The object key and digest are not relayed.

MessagingDeletionRequest.description: One principal erasure or conversation purge request and its counts.

MessagingAuditEntry.description: One chat audit entry. Its detail object is not relayed.

MessagingSwitch.description: One emergency off-switch (global or per environment). A switch only stops a capability.

MessagingIncident.description: One operational incident. Its summary text is not relayed.

MessagingFailedMessage.description: One outbox event in DEAD_LETTER. Its payload and error string are not relayed.

MessagingKeyTransparency.description: Key-transparency status: the tree head (null before the first leaf) and each witness state. No key material.

CallingCall.description: One call of the tenant: ids, kind, state, origin, counts and times. Never a telephone number, SIP URI or display name.

CallingCallParticipant.description: One participant: principal id, kind, role and times only.

CallingCallDetail.description: One call with its participants (at most 500).

CallingAbuseReport.description: One OPEN abuse report of the tenant: bounded codes and opaque ids, never free text.

CallingBlockRule.description: One block rule. A blocked contact is only reported as present, never named.

CallingLimitPolicy.description: A limit policy; null fields are not configured.

version.description: The level's limits version (expected_version of calling.limits.change).
The level's limits version (expected_version of calling.limits.change).

CallingLimits.description: The tenant's limit policies (at most 100 applications; truncated beyond). Spend limits are in minor units of the tenant's billing currency.

CallingRoutingPolicy.description: An environment's routing policy summary. Destination and duplicate-risk sub-policies are not relayed.

CallingRoutingPolicies.description: The tenant's routing policies (at most 100; truncated beyond).

CallingEnterprisePolicy.description: An enterprise calling policy: feature switches and operator-granted administrative capabilities.

CallingEnterprisePolicies.description: The tenant's enterprise calling policies (at most 100; truncated beyond).

CallingSpendPolicy.description: A telecom spend / velocity policy; amounts in minor units of its own currency, never summed across currencies.

CallingSpendPolicies.description: The tenant's spend policies (at most 100; truncated beyond).

CallingRecording.description: Recording metadata only: never an object key or media URL.

CallingVoicemail.description: Voicemail metadata only: never an object key, media URL or caller identity.

CallingRetentionHold.description: A retention hold of the tenant or the platform. The placing operator is not relayed.

CallingIncident.description: An operational incident of the tenant or the platform. Restricted evidence and dedupe keys are never relayed.

CallingWebhookKey.description: Webhook subscriptions per signing-secret sealing key id (counts only, never a secret or sealed value).

CallingAuditEntry.description: One operator audit entry of the tenant. The detail document is never relayed.

VerificationCase.description: One verification case (HQ's shared shape). PARTNER_GO_LIVE: a production-access request (subject_ref: the project); APP_REVIEW: an app, published from the same case. OPEN, CLAIMED, then APPROVED / REJECTED (PUBLISHED, SUSPENDED); CANCELLED: withdrawn by the partner (never listed, still readable). version increases on every transition and is the commands' expected_version. evidence: hashes only.

VerificationCasePage.description: The verification queue, most recently changed first (CANCELLED cases are not listed).

VerificationCaseDetail.description: One verification case with its decision details (verification.cases.read only).

oneOf.description: PARTNER_GO_LIVE: what is asked for and what was approved (product capability ids).
APP_REVIEW: the manifest version under review and the published one.

VerificationCaseHistory.description: A case's transitions, oldest first. STAFF actions name the staff member (hq:<sub>, or operator:<name> for the operator console); a partner's own actions carry no account id.

operation_id.description: HQ's command id; equal to the Idempotency-Key header.

expected_version.description: The case version the command applies to (VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise).

VerificationClaimRequest.description: Claim a case for review (OPEN to CLAIMED). R2, no approval.

operation_id.description: HQ's command id; equal to the Idempotency-Key header.

expected_version.description: The case version the command applies to (VERSION_CONFLICT otherwise).
